svg.text: An agent may read and propose. Deterministic code decides, Banyan Sapling verifies, and only a person teaches, activates or overrules a precedent. Every model call goes through Mubit.
All in this repository. Built in: returns, AP invoices. Planted from templates, as data: meal claims, access requests, meeting invites. Business systems are simulated.
